description.narrative: Social Protection will target a minimum of 42,000 direct beneficiaries of cash for work and infrastructure rehabilitation work with a total of at least 150,000 people benefitting from access to community assets including health facilities.

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
UNDP as the Implementing Partner will comply with the policies, procedures and practices of the United Nations Security Management System (UNSMS.)

description.narrative: # of Yemeni population in need of livelihoods support , including access to income opportunities and key essential services.

comment.narrative: Around 18.8 million people in need of livelihoods support, including access to income opportunities and key essential services – including 10.3 million in acute needs (2017)
Final evaluation has been finalized and report shared with stakeholders.

Result Area 1 140 direct beneficiaries of short term wage employment received and 490 indirect beneficiaries. 120 agriculture hectors and irrigated land rehabilitated 1000 (M2) Street paved 20 of CFW recipient are paid through mobile banking out of 200 established bank accounts
Result Area 2 2500 direct beneficiaries of short term wage employment received 45 health facilities Rehabilitated out of 80. 80 solar system for health facilities installed.
Result Area 3. 200 identified SFD-recruited experts (consultants) trained in identification of severe stress and trauma for psychosocial needs.
Result Area 4. 2 district management teams trained and 2 DMTs formed 1 damage assessments conducted 8 solar systems for local authorities’ offices installed
